newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak FinMin sets two T-bill auctions for Wed.
newsitem.headline: Slovak FinMin sets two T-bill auctions for Wed.

text.p: The Slovak Finance Ministry will auction two unspecified tranches of treasury bills on Wednesday, the National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said on Monday.
The NBS said one tranche of four-week T-bills and one with a maturity of 40 weeks would be on sale.
In the last successful auction of four-week T-bills on October 23, the average yield hit 9.206 percent.

The ministry has not held a 40-week T-bill auction yet this year. But in the last successful auction of T-bills with a similar maturity were 39-week T-bills issued on November 14, whose average yield hit 9.986 percent.
